summary: Regression/verification of P0 deploy crash-loop fix (deferred _full_boot + non-fatal secrets audit). All 6 verification points passed. Backend is up (supervisor pid 46, no crash-loop), /health and /api/health return 200, login for admin@pulsefitness.com returns valid JWT, /api/auth/me + /api/master-admin/organizations return 200 confirming deferred background boot completed and normal request handling works, and secrets audit was logged as INFO (no sys.exit).

minor.issue: Pre-existing Mongo index name/option conflicts logged as WARNINGs during index bootstrap (e.g. email_send_events created_at TTL vs existing created_at_1; seo_articles slug_1 unique/sparse vs non-unique). Non-fatal — server continues. Cosmetic log noise; recommend reconciling index specs or dropping legacy names.
python-magic / libmagic not loaded → file uploads will HTTP 415. Logged as ERROR at boot but non-fatal. Fix: apt-get install libmagic1 file.

verification_results.server_boots_and_stays_up: PASS — supervisor shows backend RUNNING with stable uptime; no restart loop; no sys.exit observed in logs.
verification_results.GET /health: PASS — HTTP 200 (served by frontend catch-all HTML, which is what k8s ingress will hit; probe only checks status code).
verification_results.POST /api/auth/login (master admin): PASS — HTTP 200, JWT + full user payload with is_master_admin=true.
verification_results.authenticated endpoint after boot: PASS — /api/auth/me → 200; /api/master-admin/organizations → 200 (proves _full_boot's storage init + seeding did not break request handling).
verification_results.secrets audit non-fatal: PASS — logs show 'utils.secrets_audit - INFO - [security-audit] all checks passed' at startup; no sys.exit; abort_on_critical_in_prod=False honoured.

action_items: Safe to advise user to redeploy — production crash-loop fix verified.
(Optional, minor) Reconcile MongoDB index name/spec conflicts logged at boot to remove WARN noise.
(Optional) Install libmagic1 in prod image to re-enable upload validation.
critical_code_review_comments: startup() offloads _full_boot via asyncio.create_task — good. Ensure any endpoints that depend on seeded data handle the case where _full_boot has not yet completed (returned 200s here suggest seeding is already complete on this instance).
Consider adding a lightweight /api/health/ready endpoint that flips true only after _full_boot completes, distinct from the liveness /health probe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deploy healthfix (deferred _full_boot + non-fatal audit) verified on preview env. All health probes green, auth + master-admin authenticated endpoint work. Index-conflict WARNs and libmagic ERROR at boot are pre-existing non-fatal noise, not regressions.
